Package frc.robot.aiming

Class AimParams

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.aiming.AimParams
public class AimParams extends Object
A snapshot of all computed shot parameters for a single aiming pipeline evaluation.

Role in the Pipeline

The aiming pipeline produces an AimParams object each time an aim strategy is queried: 
   LeadCompensator â†’ ToFAim.update() â†’ AimParams
This object is then consumed by:
  • Shooter.shoot â€” reads pitch, output, and control to drive the hood and flywheel.
  • Turret.track â€” reads yaw and deltaYaw to servo the turret toward the required field-relative heading.
  • RobotStateMachine.isShootReady â€” compares actual mechanism positions against the delta* tolerance fields to decide whether it is safe to fire.

Validity Model

Not every call to the pipeline produces a usable shot. Reasons a shot might be impossible: target not in camera view, robot out of range, turret at a travel limit. The status field encodes validity. Callers should always check isOk() before using numeric fields. Use the impossible() factory to create an empty, safe "no shot" sentinel.

  • Field Details

    • status

      public AimParams.AimStatus status
      Validity of this params object. Callers check isOk() before using numeric fields. Defaults to AimParams.AimStatus.Unchecked on construction.

    • control

      public AimParams.SpeedControl control
      How to interpret the output field. Either a desired ball exit speed in m/s, or a raw mechanism RPS value from a calibrated lookup table.

    • pitch

      public edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Rotation2d pitch
      Required launch pitch angle, measured from horizontal in the robot frame. The hood servo positions itself to achieve this launch angle. Positive = more upward (high hub), negative = flatter (close shot).

    • yaw

      public edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Rotation2d yaw
      Required turret yaw, in the field coordinate frame. The turret converts this to a mechanism angle using: mechanismAngle = fieldYaw âˆ’ robotHeading + kForwards. Stored field-relative so it is unaffected by robot rotation between updates.

    • output

      public double output
      Required launch speed. Interpreted as m/s ball velocity when control == ProjectileVelocity, or as wheel RPS when control == MechanismControl. Populated from the distance-to-speed lookup table in ToFAim.

    • deltaPitch

      public edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Rotation2d deltaPitch
      Maximum tolerated hood pitch error for a "ready to fire" signal. Default Â±4Â°. Tighter values improve accuracy; looser values allow shooting sooner.

    • deltaYaw

      public edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Rotation2d deltaYaw
      Maximum tolerated turret yaw error for a "ready to fire" signal. Default Â±4Â°. At 5 m range, 4Â° corresponds to roughly 35 cm of aim error at the hub â€” well within hub radius.

    • deltaOutput

      public double deltaOutput
      Maximum tolerated flywheel speed error for a "ready to fire" signal, in the same units as output. Default 1.5 RPS (roughly 3% of full speed at typical FRC shooting speeds).

    • tof

      public double tof
      Time-of-flight in seconds: elapsed time between ball leaving the shooter and reaching the hub. Populated by ToFAim.update(edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Pose3d, edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Pose3d, edu.wpi.first.math.geometry.Translation2d) from the calibrated distance-to-time lookup table. Used by LeadCompensator to compute the forward lead offset, and published as telemetry via Aiming/LeadOffsetXM and Aiming/LeadOffsetYM.

    • setupLogging

      public static void setupLogging(OnboardLogger log, Supplier<AimParams> params)
      Registers all aim parameter fields with an OnboardLogger under the "Aiming/" namespace. This is a static registration â€” each supplier is evaluated every time the logger flushes, so the telemetry always reflects the current pipeline output without requiring the caller to push updates manually.

      Called once in RobotStateMachine constructor. All subsequent writes to SmartDashboard for aiming telemetry go through this logger â€” no individual put* calls.

      Parameters:
      log - the logger instance scoped to the "Aiming" namespace
      params - supplier of the current AimParams object (called each flush)
